scene: WL101A/WL101C SSS cfg0 and existing six-event physical reference on ecro_lr3_adapter
runtime: LabServer63, existing WL101 Mitsuba 3.8.0 / Dr.Jit 1.3.1 / OptiX 595.71.05; original optimized WL101 RT and pt100.Ctx.trace
oracle: Original WL100 pt100.Ctx.field_components inherited by the unchanged WL101 RT, current cfg0 source, kmax=5 probe. Average outgoing radiance E2+E3–E5 by the original uniform-area, uniform-z/phi bin draws and original first-hit count; no cosine, bin-solid-angle or area multiplier.
oracle_aggregation: Two independent halves, replicas 1–2 and 3–4. Score all four separately. Arithmetic table and image means are equivalent under linear fixed readout.
readout: Same unmodified rt101.render_hq as WL101A. Two 4096-spp camera streams with 32-spp launches, seeds 101100 and 101101. Reuse the bit-verified WL101A matched learned images and archived physical halves. Trace all new Oracle tables through these two seeds. LOW must match archived matched learned and physical LOW.
preflight: Check exact input hashes, archived learned table, patch/bin support including numerical misroutes, five-event probe E2 / E3–E5 against camera-mode same suffix on valid rays, actual readout addressing and zero/linearity controls. Physical port/path code is unchanged. If a malformed or zero-count table slot is used by the qualified camera, stop.
precision: For near and near-minus-flank, report independent table, camera readout and reference noise. Approximate conservative 95% t intervals combine table-mean (4), camera/paired-reference (2) variation in quadrature with Welch degrees of freedom. Include separate paired reference half difference and unpaired comparator as descriptive. To qualify attribution require combined interval half-width <= 25% of each WL101C historic signed endpoint magnitude for both contributions.
attribution: Signed linear-HDR Rec.709 arithmetic on original WL101C masks. Report T=learned-physical, G=learned-Oracle, R=Oracle-physical; verify T=G+R and report G/T and R/T with uncertainty propagated using the frozen positive historic denominator as sensitivity. Nonpositive or unresolved total is inconclusive.
rule: If precision and contract pass at both endpoints: GENERATOR-DOMINANT when G is resolved positive at both and R is unresolved at both; REPRESENTATION/READOUT-DOMINANT when R is resolved positive at both and G unresolved at both; MIXED when R and G both have a resolved contribution at either endpoint, or the two endpoints resolve different owners. An opposite-sign contribution is compensation. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. If scientific precision fails, retain outputs and stop without a new estimator.
roi: Frozen WL101C gbuffer, near, flank, contact/shadow, full, original radial profile and signed color range
stop: Stop on an unresolved quantity or renderer-semantic mismatch, meaningful use of malformed support, incompatible LOW, or unqualified uncertainty. This diagnostic grants no training or architecture change.
